value.rationale: Idempotent Rota–Baxter operators encode direct-sum decompositions of finite étale algebras; enumeration on nonsplit finite field extensions is a natural analogue of the classical split product case. The closed formula resolves the arithmetic dependence on extension degrees and demonstrates the unexpected independence of field size. It also proves the previously conjectural split-case number rather than merely checking small tables. The complete general case is a motivated nonroutine classification, though no downstream application or universal priority is asserted.
